description: U.S. Light-Duty BEV Adoption and Electricity Demand Projections, 2026–2040 — Data and Code is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Saeid Derakhshani Koshki. This dataset accompanies a forthcoming paper in Energy Reports forecasting U.S. light-duty battery electric vehicle (BEV) adoption and incremental electricity demand for all 50 states and the District of Columbia, 2026–2040. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
